preflight.objective: Validate the N7.6 WhatsApp Business integration against a real authorized provider/runtime in Desarrollo without touching Produccion, deploy, secrets or PR #2.
preflight.authorityReuse: docs/CERTIFICACION_N7_6_WHATSAPP_BUSINESS.md certifies tenant-scoped configuration, E.164 phone, opaque sensitive references, persistence/migration, fail-closed HTTP boundary, scoped anonymous webhook, authenticated configuration endpoints, truthful frontend, RBAC/audit/security and regression gates.
preflight.externalGap: N7.6 explicitly does not claim provider message delivery outside the observed contract. N8.6 must obtain that real-provider proof; mocks, invented QR/session state or local-only responses cannot satisfy it.
scope: Exercise the existing certified boundary against an authorized non-production WhatsApp provider/account in Desarrollo.
Prove truthful provider state/message delivery or provider response correlation without exposing access tokens, phone-number IDs, webhook secrets or recipient PII.
Verify tenant/RBAC remains enforced and webhook validation remains fail-closed.
Route code/schema/UI/security changes to B-F only if inspection proves an internal gap; otherwise document causal N/A.
outOfScope: main, Produccion, deploy, secrets/credential changes, PR #2, fabricated provider state, unapproved recipients.
risks: Provider access token/phone-number/account verification is external and intentionally secret.
Real messaging can affect external recipients and therefore requires an authorized non-production test identity/recipient.
Webhook/provider verification may require an externally reachable callback and provider-side configuration beyond repository control.
acceptance: Real provider evidence is mandatory at N8.6.G or an external blocker is persisted honestly.
P0=0 and P1=0 before any LISTO_REAL.
No stage may treat local mocks as equivalent to real-provider validation.
preflight.rollback: A is evidence-only. Later runtime deltas require scoped rollback; provider-side configuration is never modified by this automation unless separately authorized.
preflight.testStrategy: Reuse N7.6 regression baseline for internal correctness and reserve N8.6.G for one authorized real-provider validation with non-secret correlation evidence.
